name: DL-eutylone
summary: Eutylone is a stimulant and empathogenic drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, phenylisobutylamine, and cathinone families. It was developed in the 1960s and first reported to the EMCDDA in 2014. Eutylone is a designer drug which became widespread internationally in 2019–2020 following bans on the related compound ephylone. It is a synthetic cathinone.
